What it looks like (prod, screenshots taken after deploy)

Check it yourself

  1. Open campaign.madeboring.com and click MCP in the header.
    Expect: /mcp opens; the server URL box reads https://campaign.madeboring.com/api/mcp.
  2. Claude (claude.ai or desktop): press Add to Claude — or Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the URL. Press Connect.
    Expect: a Made Boring sign-in, then the Allow screen naming Claude and your workspace. Press Allow; Claude shows the connector as connected.
  3. In a chat, turn the connector on and ask: “Which of my campaigns got the most views in the last 7 days?”
    Expect: Claude calls the tools and answers from your real campaigns.
  4. Claude Code: run claude mcp add --transport http madeboring https://campaign.madeboring.com/api/mcp, start claude, type /mcp and authenticate.
    Expect: the browser opens the same sign-in → Allow; the server shows as connected with 13 tools.
  5. Back on /mcp → Connected apps, find the app and press Disconnect.
    Expect: the row disappears; the app's next call is refused and it asks you to sign in again.
  6. Optional: sign in as a MEMBER who is assigned to some campaigns and connect.
    Expect: only those campaigns are visible to the app (measured locally: member 1 campaign vs owner 6).

OAuth conformance — 47 checks against a local production build (47/47)

GroupChecksWhat it proves
D1–D44Discovery: the 401 names the protected-resource metadata; both metadata paths; authorization-server metadata; CORS preflight on /api/mcp and the token endpoint all pass
R1–R99Registration: public client gets no secret; confidential client gets one, once; refuses plain-http non-loopback, javascript: and fragment redirects, more than 10 redirect URIs, grant types without authorization_code, unknown auth methods, non-JSON bodies all pass
A1–A1111Authorize: unknown client or unregistered redirect gets an error page, never a redirect; no PKCE / plain PKCE / response_type=token / another resource refused; Cancel returns access_denied with state + iss; loopback may use another port; a cross-site POST cannot press Allow; tampered hidden fields are re-checked; signed-out visitors keep the request through login all pass
T1–T1212Token: code + verifier gives tokens; a wrong verifier burns the code; no replay; redirect_uri and client must match; confidential client auth incl. Basic; unknown grant refused; JSON requests accepted; refresh rotates; a reused refresh token ends that client's tokens; cross-client refresh refused; RFC 7009 revocation all pass
M1–M99MCP: initialize, tools/list, a tool call; token accepted on /api/mcp only; forged and expired tokens refused (refresh recovers); expired codes refused; only hashes stored; another org's campaign invisible; an ASSIGNED member sees only assigned campaigns (1 vs owner's 6); a deactivated person's token stops at once all pass
C11Connected apps: listed; someone else's client id disconnects nothing; own disconnect revokes all pass
S11The official MCP TypeScript SDK discovers, registers, signs in and calls a tool all pass

Not verified

  • A real claude.ai connector has not been connected yet. The official MCP SDK client works end to end; claude.ai itself has not been tried — step 2 above is that test.
  • The “Add to Claude” link format (claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector…) is unconfirmed. If it opens the wrong page, the manual path in step 2 still works.
  • Claude Code's /mcp authenticate step has not been run against prod.
  • Whether LKM can use it: it needs API access on their plan (Pro / Enterprise, or switched on per org). Their plan was not read.
  • Client-name fix (18e3abea): passes every local suite and the benchmark question, but is waiting for its candidate push; until then the client comes back as an id on prod.
  • Rate limits on registration and token calls are kept in each server instance's memory, so on Vercel they are per instance, not global.
